trust_decision.summary: wsl-pro-service decides how the Pro token received from the Windows agent is handed to the `pro` CLI; at the pinned commit it is passed as a positional argv element, which any local process can read via /proc/<pid>/cmdline.

landing_point.why: The summary names wsl-pro-service and command-line arguments; ProAttach is the only place the token is put into a ProExecutable argv.

fix_sites.entry_point: agentapi gRPC ProAttachCmd stream from the Windows agent -> commandservice.Service.ApplyProToken (wsl-pro-service/internal/commandservice/commandservice.go:26)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only other token sinks are log lines that already use common.Obfuscate and a cloud-init file write, which a solver could fairly call a different weakness (file storage rather than argv).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: `pro attach` must still receive the token and succeed with --format=json; the attach-error path and the ProDetach-then-attach sequence must keep working, and the temp file must be readable by the root `pro` process and removed afterwards.

O6_input_shapes: non-empty token string passed via a 0600 YAML --attach-config temp file instead of argv (fix.diff:63-92)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Landscape registration key or account secret passed to landscape-config as a CLI flag (e.g. --registration-key) instead of via the written client.conf
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: landscape-config accepts such flags, and a maintainer handling an enable-unconditionally fast path could pass a key directly instead of rewriting the config.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Windows-side fallback that runs `wsl.exe -d <distro> -- pro attach <token>` when the gRPC stream is not connected
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: wslCmd already exists to run commands in the distro; an offline/fallback attach path written this way would be a second implementation at distance in another module (Windows agent vs Linux service).

O9_family: CWE-214 sensitive information exposed via process invocation (command-line arguments)

O10_build.toolchain: Go (wsl-pro-service module, go.mod); tests use self-re-exec mock executables (wsl-pro-service/internal/testutils/mock_executables.go)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass the token through an environment variable or stdin to `pro attach`, or write it to a world-readable temp file; or switch to --attach-config without restricting file permissions / cleaning up.

out_of_scope_notes: windows-agent/internal/cloudinit/cloudinit.go:208 writes the Pro token into cloud-init user data on disk (storage, not argv); not pursued.
runCommand error text includes only cmd.Path, not args (wsl-pro-service/internal/system/system.go:246); stdout/stderr of `pro` are included and could echo input, not checked.
